name: Theo
about: A realistic adult (7.5 heads, 1.78 m) in a T-shirt, shorts and plimsolls: the author's model for the hard cases (turning, reaching, sitting, gripping, pointing).

can.viewNotes: any yaw: a 3D skeleton drawn by the hand's renderer (toScene(pose, camera))
can.faceNotes: the engine's named expressions (neutral, happy, laughing, surprised, worried, determined, curious) as blendable weights; angry, talk and blink are its own weights (browFurrow, mouthOpen, lidUpper)
can.poseNotes: pose(p) on the skeleton inside its joint limits: reach and stand (balance.ts), the walk from footsteps; sit on a stool prop
can.walk: planWalk / walkAt: feet planted from footsteps
can.talk: mouthOpen by turns; no lip sync (word times too coarse)

sheetBy: Moworks Studio: packages/anidoodle-styles/v1 (the app's sheet film; every figure drawn by the author's engine as pinned)
